scope: Primary split only; reference 410131+410132 EDH, test 410133. Existing stage3 results known; not a blind theoretical confirmation.

sampling.contiguous: For each M independently, 200 starts iid uniform integers 0..80000-M inclusive. Each draw uses consecutive M saved frames. Repeated starts allowed and recorded.
sampling.dispersed: For each M independently, 200 subsets, each M distinct frame indices uniformly without replacement from all 80000 test frames. Sort indices for reading only. Subsets across repeats may overlap.
sampling.pairing: EDH and EFS use exactly the same frame indices for each repeat. No outcome-based exclusions. All samples kept including negative EFS estimates.
sampling.order: ascending M; contiguous starts then dispersed subsets for each M; one numpy.default_rng stream; save exact arrays before analysis

estimation: Use unchanged gb3d_estimators.estimate on full domain [0.55,6] then retain bins wholly within [0.9,5.5], channels0:128 angular plus128 radial. Float64. Per-frame values averaged, never use 100-frame means as individual frames.
reference: equal average of both 80000-frame EDH reference means; no test frames and no EFS as truth
loss: Weighted NRMSE, squared weights shell volume normalized across selected radial bins and 1/128 angular measure. Denominator fixed norm of pooled EDH reference. No occupancy mask.
report: Per M/mode/method/channel retain all 200 errors; report sqrt(mean(error^2)), mean error, empirical 2.5/50/97.5 percentiles and threshold hit fraction. Quantiles are a conditional sampling range, not a confidence interval for equilibrium truth.
intervals: Paired resampling of 200 repeat indices, 2000 draws. Percentile 95% interval of sqrt(mean(error^2)), and EFS/EDH RMS-error ratio. These quantify finite repeat Monte Carlo uncertainty conditional on the fixed 80000-frame test pool and estimated reference; they do NOT make overlapping windows independent physical samples or include between-chain uncertainty.
reference_uncertainty: Report separate conservative triangle envelopes max(0,error-u95)..error+u95 using maximum reference error norm95 over blocks500/1000/2000/4000. Not a joint95% confidence band. Keep all block sensitivity and compatibility results.
sample_savings: Only sampled M grid, no interpolation/extrapolation. First M whose upper conditional RMS-error CI plus max reference u95 lies below target and stays below at all larger tested M. If none, report >20000. Ratios explicitly conditional on this test chain and sampling design, not universal. Retain unresolved stage3 seed residual difference.
cost: Dispersed draws require access to an 80000-frame chain even when M is small. Report selected NC, source span and original simulation cost separately; do not claim shorter acquisition from dispersed M alone.
resume: Immutable per100-frame cache files, validate every block against existing estimator100 means before committing atomic status. Never restart when worker alive; failed partial output preserved and recovery audited.
pending: Leave-one-out rotations exploratory and not implemented in this primary run. Full-chain uncertainty not established by repeat intervals.
